traitdesc-machinist: Can make, install and operate helve hammers, pulverizers, chutes and other kinds of machinery
traitdesc-sailwright: Can make large sails, more efficient at making normal-sized sails
traitdesc-shipwright: Can build sailboats for efficient overseas travel
traitdesc-smith: Can work with advanced (Tier 3+) anvils and operate bellows
traitdesc-distiller: Can install and work with boilers
traitdesc-apothecary: Can craft basic healing items more efficiently, exclusive access to advanced healing items
